title: Microsoft Purview: Azure PST Import to Exchange Online mailboxes (GCC, GCC High and DoD)
summary: The briefing accurately separates the government-cloud roadmap target from the Global rollout described in Microsoft's notice. Its prerequisites, licensing context and Azure role-assignment controls are supported; searches found no feature-specific Learn guidance or additional published licensing or charges.

claims.quote: Network upload: Upload the PST files over the network to a temporary Azure Storage location in the Microsoft cloud.

claims.claim: The existing PST Import service supports drive shipping.
claims.quote: Drive shipping: Copy the PST files to a BitLocker-encrypted hard drive and then physically ship the drive to Microsoft.

claims.claim: The existing service uses an import job created in the Microsoft Purview portal.
claims.quote: Create a PST import job on the Import PST files page in the Microsoft Purview portal and submit the PST import mapping file you created in the previous step.

claims.claim: The printed Azure portal path selects Storage Blob Data Reader and the Office 365 Import Service principal at storage-account scope.

claims.claim: The printed az role assignment create command assigns Storage Blob Data Reader using an assignee object ID, principal type and storage-account scope.

az role assignment create \

    --assignee-object-id "aaaaaaaa-0000-1111-2222-bbbbbbbbbbbb" \

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not document a cmdlet or parameter specifically for the Azure PST Import workflow at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Azure PST Import" PowerShell cmdlets Analyze migration endpoint licensing default roles'; read New-MigrationEndpoint and New-MigrationBatch. PSTImport is on-premises-only; Analyze describes mailbox analysis without identifying Azure PST Import. No feature-specific call found.

claims.claim: Azure role-assignment changes at this scope can take up to 10 minutes to take effect.
claims.quote: When you assign roles or remove role assignments, it can take up to 10 minutes for changes to take effect.

claims.claim: The supplied notice labels its rollout Global without explaining how that label maps to the roadmap's government clouds.
claims.quote: This message is associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 565865 ... Global: We will begin rolling out early April 2027

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated an additional default beyond the administrator-driven import workflow.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Azure PST Import" documentation Analyze mode New-MigrationBatch default permissions roles'; read MC1455013, PST import overview and migration references. No additional feature-specific default found; the notice explicitly says admin-driven and PowerShell-only.
